en: A vintage, colorized postcard view of a powerful waterfall rushing through a rocky gorge, with pine-covered cliffs on both sides. Above the gorge spans a light metal truss bridge supported by stone abutments. At the top of the image there is printed text in Swedish that reads: "Trollhättan. Östra Toppöfallet." The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
